verdicts.reason: A drops the Solstice logo and dark brand band. The headline wraps to three lines on the left. The body copy is stretched into one long line too small to read, and the tiny CTA sits jammed under it, so the button is buried. B keeps the logo and dark strip on the left and groups the headline with the CTA in the centre, which gives a clearer focal point. But its wrapped body copy is nearly as heavy as the headline and competes with it, the legal block is illegible, and the eyebrow is lost in both.
